jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: Morgan School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Morgan). Non-operating (tuitions its students out).
North Country SU Morgan School Board page (official).

sources.note: Morgan School District: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a). Only two memberships are minted; the third seat's 2026-2027 status is undocumented (Janet Selby held it in 2025-2026 and vanishes from the 2026-2027 block with no successor or vacancy documented -- missing: the Morgan March 2026 annual meeting / reorganization minutes and the Town of Morgan Annual Report officers list). No term expirations are published for any member. North Country SU Morgan School Board page (official): year blocks -- 2024-2025: Danielle Blake (Chair), Sean Selby, Tammy Lacourse; 2025-2026: Blake (Chair), Janet Selby, Lacourse; 2026-2027: ONLY Blake (Chair) and Tammy Lacourse (Vice Chair, Clerk). No term expirations are published for any member. The NCSU Full Board page corroborates Blake and Lacourse ("LaCourse" there) as the current directors.

directors.name: Danielle Blake
directors.note: Board Chair across all three published year blocks. No term end published.

directors.name: Tammy Lacourse
directors.note: Vice Chair/Clerk 2026-2027. Name per the Morgan board page ("Lacourse" in all three blocks; the SU Full Board page prints "LaCourse"). A news report that she won a new 3-year term in March 2026 is a lead only -- no end asserted.
